title: Planned MSM Sun Trust gathering / regional committee, 6 February
reason: The available contemporaneous accounts describe a partisan gathering at party headquarters intended to signal to opposition and critics or counter an announced opposition march. They do not establish an executed public protest with a demand directed to the state. The stated aim to bring 500 people was a planned personal target, not turnout.
notes: Occurrence on 6 February remains unverified. Keep excluded from events unless later evidence establishes an executed public demonstration and qualifying state-directed demand.
